A radiative-transfer solver needs, in every layer and at every spectral point, three things: how strongly the layer
attenuates light, what fraction of the attenuation is scattering, and in which directions the scattered light goes.
pyharp computes them in *opacity sources*: modules that turn the state of a layer (concentrations, pressure,
temperature, droplet size) into an extinction coefficient, a single-scattering albedo and phase-function moments.
A band lists its sources in the radiation YAML; this chapter describes how a source is selected and what it must
return, and then the sources of the chapter one by one: Rayleigh scattering by gas molecules, liquid-water droplets
by Lorenz-Mie theory, and a pre-mixed correlated-k table. A fourth source the code contains, the Helios table, is
refused whenever a band asks for it. How a band sums its sources into one solver input is the subject of the
assembly chapter, not of this one.

@fig-ch06-map shows how the sections relate, and @tbl-ch06-schemes lists them.

Every number, table and figure of this chapter is regenerated by one command, `derivation-checks/ch06_run.sh
<venv 1.7.1> <venv 1.8.13>`, which runs the four checks in both environments, rewrites their outputs and the figure
data, and redraws the figures. The environments are built from public pins only by
`derivation-checks/ch06_setup.sh`: pyharp at the code pin, built from source on the CPU with NetCDF, pydisort 1.7.1
or 1.8.13 from its published wheel checked by hash, and torch 2.10.0. The CPU build needs no patch; with `cuda` and
an nvcc older than 12.8 the script applies `derivation-checks/ch06_setup/cuda-arch-sm120.patch` to pyharp's CMake
list of CUDA architectures, and nothing else. The second line of every output records the pyharp and pydisort
commits, the torch build, the CPU, the GPU and the compilers of the run.

| section | option | default | main check |
|---|---|---|---|
| @sec-ch06-sources | `opacities:` entry, `type` | none (required) | `check_ch06_sources.py` |
| @sec-ch06-rayleigh | `type: rayleigh` | off | `check_ch06_rayleigh.py` |
| @sec-ch06-mie | `type: water-liquid-mie` | off | `check_ch06_mie.py` |
| @sec-ch06-picaso | `type: picaso-ck` | off | `check_ch06_picaso.py` |
| @sec-ch06-helios | `type: helios` | refused | `check_ch06_sources.py` [C4] |
